leadText: Motonari (Japanese: モトナリ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.
plainText:
Motonari (Japanese: モトナリ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest. 

==In the games==
 
 

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 60% link with Servine or Serperior while at least 100 Pokémon are registered in the Gallery.

===Default Pokémon===
 
 
===Links===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Unobtainable links====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Oh, I see! You're still asleep."
With low health or a status ailment:
"Oh dear..."
When victory is near:
"Let's wrap this one up."
Otherwise:
"Okay, let's get started then."

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle:
"Who will prove victorious today?"
When defending a castle:
"Give our guests a cordial welcome."

During battle:
"The best thing about battles is that there are always Pokémon around. I particularly like it when I catch sight of a Pokémon I've never seen before!"

When ordering to attack:
" ! Now's our chance!"

When ordering to go to battle:
To a kingdom:
"Well, well... I can't wait to see what kind of enemy we're faced with!"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"Let's hope we encounter someone new!"

Upon forming a link:
"Come with me, ."

When using an item:
"Time for my !"

When using his Warrior Skill:
"How about this?"

After winning a battle:
If he attacked a castle:
"Now this is progress, whichever way you look at it."
If he defended a castle:
"We have survived another day. But how long will this peace last?"

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"A fine performance, I must say. You fight splendidly."
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"Well, I suppose battle always contains unexpected elements..."
Otherwise:
"Oh dear. It looks like you were too good for us."

When being recruited:
"Well... I'm sure I'd regret it if I didn't accept your invitation..."

When there are 10 Warriors in the army:
"Our circle of allies is expanding, but we've still got to make a big effort to find plenty more. I'm relying on you too, !"

At the start of :
"I know this is a bit sudden… But it's no secret that I've always wanted to be a Pokémon researcher. To that end...I want to expand my horizons and meet some new Pokémon. In order to do so, of course, I shall need an army… I take it there are no objections?"
"Oh no, certainly not. My only aim is to link with some new Pokémon. Let's say...a hundred or so. I hope you can help me achieve this goal!"
At the end of :
"Well, it looks like I managed to reach my target. One hundred Pokémon… I've met all sorts of different ones along the way… But I'm sure there are some Pokémon that I still haven't come across… What an exciting thought! ...But it can wait for tomorrow. For now, I think I had better take a rest."

When the story's mission is failed:
"Well, well... So this is the end..."

===Profile===
A reasonable and rational Warrior who shows exceptional tactical awareness in battle. His dream is to dedicate himself to the academic research of Pokémon.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Motonari debuted in PNA2.
 
====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==

===Historical origin===
Motonari is based on the real-life of Japanese history. Takamoto ( ), Motoharu ( ), and Takakage ( ) were his sons. Terumoto ( ) was his grandson by Takamoto, and Takakage adopted Hideaki ( ), a previously adopted son of Hideyoshi's. Ekei ( ) was a monk serving as a diplomat to the .
